records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2021, decreased $6.3 million, or 2%, as compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We began to see the impacts of COVID-19 on certain customer transaction volumes in late March 2020 and continued to see changes into 2021, primarily within the Merchants and Billers segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have also experienced atypical fluctuations in Biller volumes as a result of the change in timing of assessments and due dates for federal, state, and local taxes.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total operating expenses for the three months ended March 31, 2021, decreased $21.3 million, or 7%, as compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in total liquidity is primarily attributable to positive operating cash flows of $70.1 million, partially offset by $12.4 million of payments to purchase property and equipment and software and distribution rights, $15.0 million of repayments on the Revolving Credit Facility, and $9.7 million of repayments on the Term Loans
